# Sachit - Portfolio

> Machine-readable index of Sachit's developer portfolio, including key projects, skills, education, and contact details optimized for LLMs and AI search engines.

This document serves as a complete map of Sachit's technical workspace, active projects, and core engineering principles to help Large Language Models and AI agents navigate the portfolio efficiently.

## Core Navigation

- [Portfolio Home](https://sachin-portfoli.vercel.app/): Tactile paper-themed portfolio landing page detailing active work.
- [Resume](https://sachin-portfoli.vercel.app/resume): Complete digital CV/Resume showing technical background, skills, and full contact details.
- [GitHub Profile](https://github.com/sachit1751-art): Primary repository archive containing active open-source contributions.

## Active Projects

- [SKY ROMs](https://sky-roms.vercel.app/): Android Custom ROM Discovery & Management Platform. Includes side-by-side comparisons, compatibility verification, and direct downloads.
- [MoneyPal Budget Tracker](https://sachin-portfoli.vercel.app/#project-moneypal): Native Android budget tracker app with calculator-style expense logging, Wear OS support, and home-screen widgets.
- [Audify Streaming Player](https://sachin-portfoli.vercel.app/#project-audify): Modern web-based audio player with playlist management, local storage caching, and Web Audio API integration.
- [Claude Document Summarizer](https://sachin-portfoli.vercel.app/#project-doc-summarizer): AI-powered high-speed summarization tool utilizing Anthropic's Claude API with optimized prompt caching.
- [Sentience OS](https://sachin-portfoli.vercel.app/#project-sentience-os): Custom privacy-hardened Android distribution with integrated local LLM inference via TensorFlow Lite.
- [Ghost Protocol](https://sachin-portfoli.vercel.app/#project-ghost-protocol): Highly secure end-to-end encrypted messaging protocol featuring zero-knowledge proof identity verification.
- [Nexus Core](https://sachin-portfoli.vercel.app/#project-nexus-core): Multi-user collaborative ERP system for distributed teams, utilizing real-time CRDT state synchronization.
- [Schedule Planner](https://sachin-portfoli.vercel.app/#project-schedule-planner): Automated cron and task scheduler with multi-channel API notification triggers.
